rules.title: Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C: prohibition on algorithmic devices used to set rents
rules.requirement: Prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation.
rules.coverage_text: Algorithmic devices, such as software programs that use algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to give a landlord recommendations on what rent to charge for a vacant unit; applies to residential units in San Francisco.
rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
